MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 and Smart Plug feel like useful additions to my home electronics: a larger display and voice control for a household device give me uses beyond my existing TV setup.",
    "The memory cards connect to my interest in recording equipment, although I would need to confirm compatibility and capacity before choosing them."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "More Fire TV Sticks offer little additional use because I already have a 4K Stick and a Fire TV television; a themed remote cover does not give me a reason to add another.",
    "Alexa in the car, a tablet, earbuds, and a reading device serve needs I have not expressed through my recent focus on home viewing and cameras.",
    "The Echo Show 5 fits my interests, but I would choose the larger Show 8 rather than buy both."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any Amazon device, even when its purpose differs from what I use at home.",
    "Repeated streaming-device suggestions assume that something similar to what I already own is automatically useful to buy again."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own matters: I am more interested in adding a useful capability than duplicating my existing streaming setup.",
    "My camera and recording purchases suggest practical accessory needs, but storage is only useful if it fits the equipment and recording requirements.",
    "Shared Alexa features matter most when they support a home use I want, rather than simply appearing on another device."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my interest in connected home electronics but stretch it too broadly across Amazon devices and repeat streaming functions I already have."
}
